answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 6753 Country: India Title: I am working as a Business Development Manager in website development company.Company designs and develops websites which involves images and photographs. I do sales and marketing for the company(I am not involved in design work)Is this job halal? Please reply. Question: As Salamu alaikum. I am working as a Business Development Manager in website development company.Company designs and develops websites which involves images and photographs. I do sales and marketing for the company(I am not involved in design work)Is this job halal? Please reply. Jazakallhu khair. Answer ID: 6753 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 889/822=L/1429) If you are not involved in picture designing, but you only do marketing for the company then this job is allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
